name: Sennou Kouro ~Alien no Naedoko ni Michibikareru Elite Onna Gunjin-tachi~
original_name: 洗脳航路 ～エイリアンの苗床に導かれるエリート女軍人たち～
source:
In the near future, a ship called "Amazons" is traveling through space. It is on a special mission, carrying a certain cargo. The crew does not know that the cargo contains a "dangerous space creature which has tentacles."

At some point, "it" gets out of the cargo and attacks the crew. The surviving crew members, now cornered, are trying to escape the ship......

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1256267]Getchu[/url]]
